knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Approval against the assessment and verified competence come first. Willingness and tape do not meet the requirement.
Removal happens in the designated zone in the trained sequence.

practicalCriteria: On a fictional hazard card, the learner states which PPE the assessment requires and what training must be verified. Pass: both are stated.
The learner records the approval and verification steps before entry, in order. Pass: approval comes before entry.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: PPE is not approved against the assessment.
A worker's competence is not verified.
Removal would take place outside the designated zone.
